sloka: लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या च अपि भार्यया ।तस्य भार्या जनस्थानात् रावणेन हृता बलात् ॥४-५२-५॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vaidehyā ca api bhāryayā ।tasya bhāryā janasthānāt rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt ॥4-52-5॥

translations.english: 'Rama, son of Dasaratha, a prosperous king of all the worlds, comparable to Indra and Varuna came to the Dandaka forest along with his brother Laksmana and wife Vaidehi. Ravana abducted his wife from Janasthana.
translations.hindi: हे धमचारिणी ! हमको बढ़ा भारी काम करना था--वइ कास हम यहाँ रहने के कारण नहीं कर सके
